approvedStylePrompt: Use the attached ACTUAL GAME BOSS as the STRICT style guide. Create a concept sheet of FIVE elite monsters for the SAME game. Style must match reference: very simple flat Chinese folk papercut, compact geometric outline, only 4-5 opaque flat colors per monster (cinnabar, burgundy, ivory, dark jade, muted gold), large mask-like faces and big graphic eyebrows, simple eyes. Slightly endearing stubborn/serious expressions, NOT horror and NOT sugary chibi. Broad crisp flat shapes, NO rendering, NO shading gradients, NO tiny ornamental details. Five equally sized isolated designs across pale cream sheet: 1 compact red umbrella spirit with big round ivory face peeking under a simple red parasol; 2 squat red lantern spirit with big eyes and two small antler branches; 3 round paper marionette spirit with mask face, stubby paper sleeves and three red strings; 4 stocky stone-carrying mountain ape, big ivory face and one simple stone stele; 5 plump moth with simple paired eyespots and friendly serious large face. Each design limited to roughly 12 main flat shapes and 3 accent motifs, looks like existing reference's companion enemy. Short stocky proportions, large faces legible at 80px. No exposed bones, skulls, sharp fangs, torn flesh, thin human bodies, scary realistic faces, jewelry, lace textures, weathering or realistic moth anatomy. Numbers 1-5 only, no UI, no scenery. This is a game art redesign toward simplicity, not a detailed fantasy illustration.

chapterSpritePrompts.valley: Take this APPROVED simple game character sheet and REMOVE ONLY THE BACKGROUND to true transparent alpha. Preserve the five exact simplified flat red/ivory/darkjade/gold paper-cut monster designs and their proportions. Five isolated fullbody sprites left to right on ONE horizontal row with wide transparent gutters: umbrella, lantern, marionette, stele ape, moth. No text, no numbers, no shadows, no ground, no glow, no vignette, no backdrop. Keep shapes SIMPLE and FLAT with 4-5 colors as shown, no added texture, no small details, no scary realism. All monsters fit fully in frame, equal cells across row. Genuinely transparent background.
chapterSpritePrompts.sea: Create five NEW sea-chapter elite sprites in the EXACT SIMPLIFIED FLAT STYLE of the attached approved reference. Change chapter palette to JADE TEAL, deep ocean green, creamy ivory and tiny muted CORAL RED/gold. NO predominantly red creatures. Same compact round proportions, large stylized mask-like face, graphic eyebrows, stern slightly endearing expressions. Not horror, not overly cute. 4-5 flat colors each, crisp broad cutpaper shapes, NO realism, no textures, no tiny ornaments, no gradients. Five fully isolated FULLBODY monsters in a single horizontal row, equal spaced cells and transparent gutters: 1 squat teal crab with two oversized ivory claws and one coral on shell; 2 rounded teal jellyfish head with big ivory eyes and 4 simple wavy short tentacles; 3 compact scallop shell spirit with serious large ivory face and one pearl; 4 squat hermit crab under a small broken Chinese sailboat shell; 5 two compact manta spirits ivory and teal linked by one thin gold ribbon, as one paired sprite. 12-18 main shapes per monster, readable at 80px. Absolutely no realistic anatomy, bones, skulls or fangs. True transparent alpha background, no scene/shadows/labels/numbers. Keep silhouettes playful and imposing like reference's simple oni boss.
chapterSpritePrompts.palace: Create five NEW star-palace elite sprites in EXACT SIMPLE FLAT PAPER-CUT STYLE and compact proportions of approved attached reference. Chapter palette INDIGO PURPLE, muted ANTIQUE GOLD, MOON IVORY, DARK NAVY; minimal red only as tiny accent. Five fullbody isolated squat spirits in single horizontal row equal cells with ample transparent gutters: 1 round ivory-faced knight with simple indigo helmet and three floating gold mirrors; 2 round-faced star weaving spirit in short indigo robe and two simple spindle shuttles; 3 compact anthropomorphic gold bronze bell with a large ivory eye-mask expression and one swinging clapper; 4 stout imperial official spirit with rectangular indigo hat and oversized square jade/gold seal; 5 round ivory-faced crescent blade spirit in short indigo robe with two sweeping simple ivory curved blades. Same big faces, crisp eyebrows, restrained serious but slightly endearing expressions as reference, NOT scary and NOT supercute. Each 12-18 broad flat geometric shapes, 4-5 colors, clean silhouettes readable at 80px. No photorealism, no shading gradients, no intricate texture/lace/costume, no skeletal human anatomy. Genuine transparent alpha background, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no numbers or labels.
